method: Manual whole1217line Item.cpp reading in four contiguous sections; bytes matched pinned Git object. No runtime execution.
findings: ScanBatch accumulates new nodes, logical/physical counts and extension deltas; flush at128children or100ms, forced before duplicate processing when enabled. Parent/tree publication precedes queueing directories/top candidates. Destructor also Flushes; allocation/exception behavior not fault-injected.

CItem destructor uses explicit descendant stack, clears descendant child vectors before deleting them, avoiding depth-proportional recursive destructor calls. MTP token unregistered per destroyed node. No million-depth memory/stack test inferred.

Name allocation checks ushort name length and size_t allocation arithmetic. Drive names use separate buffer; ordinary names use trailing allocation. Names trim trailing backslashes and retain counted length.

FindItemByPath chooses longest case-insensitive root prefix with separator boundary, then compares child components exactly/case-sensitively. This preserves case-distinct names for stored path restoration but does not accept arbitrary case variants of descendant spelling.

GetPath reconstructs MTP via root registry and ancestry; linked hardlink pseudo-file delegates to original, hardlink grouping containers have empty paths. ComparePath uses ancestor hierarchy and case-insensitive sibling-name slices, distinct from exact path lookup.

Upward size/count additions use unsigned atomic arithmetic; subtractions rely on assertions for underflow. GetItemsCount widens file/folder counts only after each32bit counter load, so widened sum does not repair earlier counter overflow.
Physical contribution returns0for hardlink-flagged nodes when ProcessHardlinks enabled; raw physical bytes remain accessible separately. This is accounting policy, not proof of data-content equality.

Scan backend selects MTP first, otherwise loaded NTFS unless forced basic, otherwise basic enumeration. Filtered directories decrement outstanding jobs; file refresh updates metadata then reprocesses duplicate/top views. Full Actions/context population still incomplete.

ScanItemsFinalize marks partial tree nodes done, so DONE alone cannot establish exhaustive source enumeration. The caller stop reason and scan state must also be considered; no all-callers runtime completeness claim.

Scan clock freezes active milliseconds under high-bit suspended marker and returns elapsed seconds as ULONG. Suspend/resume uses load/store rather than compare-exchange; correctness assumes coordinated transitions, not concurrent arbitrary callers.
limits: No Windows model, concurrent scan, cancellation, case-sensitive filesystem or allocation-error runtime execution.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation remains deferred.
